scripts.dev: chcp 65001 >nul && pnpm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "pnpm run api:dev" "pnpm run web:dev"
scripts.desktop:dev: chcp 65001 >nul && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @feedmind/api build && pnpm --filter @feedmind/desktop build && concurrently -k -n web,desktop "pnpm --filter @feedmind/web dev" "pnpm --filter @feedmind/desktop dev"
scripts.desktop:dist: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @feedmind/desktop dist && node -e "const v=require('./apps/desktop/package.json').version;require('child_process').execSync('git archive --format=zip --output=release/FeedMind-'+v+'-source.zip HEAD')"
